shortcut_name: two-shift incompatibility triggers bipartite graph coloring
evidence: All solutions immediately build an adjacency list and use a two-color traversal: `color = [-1] * n`, `color[v] = color[u] ^ 1`, and BFS/DFS checks for equal colors on adjacent vertices.
affordance_in_statement: A manufacturing facility runs two daily shifts, labeled 1 and 2 ... certain pairs of technicians cannot work during the same shift. Assign each technician a shift so that no incompatible pair works the same shift.
removal_suggestion: No meaningful rewording can remove this shortcut without changing the task's intrinsic structure: assigning one of two shifts while separating every incompatible pair is exactly bipartite coloring.
